versions.changelog: CRITICAL FIX: KB files now load on-demand only, never at boot. Prevents context bloat in multi-project workspaces. Updated Phase 7 integration guidance to enforce on-demand loading pattern. All end users must update to prevent massive context waste.
Onboarding wizard, CORRECTIONS.md self-improving log, API key setup for local/Hostinger/VPS, 9-file KB structure (PERSONA.md replaces SOUL.md, adds OPPORTUNITIES.md), living KB update flow
Initial release: Firecrawl-powered KB builder with deep analysis, adaptive Q&A, 7-file output (SOUL, CONTEXT, USER, VOICE, GUARDRAILS, SITEMAP, BUSINESS-INTEL), caching, and error recovery.
